schema.text: Which of these situations apply to your trip today?

options.text: Going to or from a bus, tram or metro stop
Going to or from a parked car
Going to or from bicycle parking
Accompanying a child (for example to school)
Using a wheelchair, walker, cane or other mobility aid

en.#Which of these situations apply to your: Which of these situations apply to your trip today?
en.#Going to or from a bus, tram or metro s: Going to or from a bus, tram or metro stop
en.#Going to or from a parked car: Going to or from a parked car
en.#Going to or from bicycle parking: Going to or from bicycle parking
en.#Accompanying a child (for example to sc: Accompanying a child (for example to school)
en.#Using a wheelchair, walker, cane or oth: Using a wheelchair, walker, cane or other mobility aid

it.#Which of these situations apply to your: Quali di queste situazioni valgono per il tuo spostamento di oggi?
it.#Going to or from a bus, tram or metro s: Vado o torno da una fermata del bus, del tram o della metro
it.#Going to or from bicycle parking: Vado o torno dal parcheggio delle bici
it.#Accompanying a child (for example to sc: Accompagno un bambino (per esempio a scuola)
it.#Using a wheelchair, walker, cane or oth: Uso una sedia a rotelle, un deambulatore, un bastone o un altro ausilio

fr.#Which of these situations apply to your: Lesquelles de ces situations s'appliquent à votre déplacement d'aujourd'hui ?
fr.#Going to or from a bus, tram or metro s: Je vais à un arrêt de bus, de tram ou de métro, ou j'en reviens
fr.#Going to or from a parked car: Je vais à une voiture garée ou j'en reviens
fr.#Going to or from bicycle parking: Je vais à un stationnement vélo ou j'en reviens
fr.#Accompanying a child (for example to sc: J'accompagne un enfant (par exemple à l'école)
fr.#Using a wheelchair, walker, cane or oth: J'utilise un fauteuil roulant, un déambulateur, une canne ou une autre aide à la mobilité

de.#Which of these situations apply to your: Welche dieser Situationen treffen auf Ihren heutigen Weg zu?
de.#Going to or from a bus, tram or metro s: Ich gehe zu einer Bus-, Straßenbahn- oder U-Bahn-Haltestelle oder komme von dort
de.#Going to or from a parked car: Ich gehe zu einem geparkten Auto oder komme von dort
de.#Going to or from bicycle parking: Ich gehe zu einem Fahrradabstellplatz oder komme von dort
de.#Accompanying a child (for example to sc: Ich begleite ein Kind (zum Beispiel zur Schule)
de.#Using a wheelchair, walker, cane or oth: Ich nutze einen Rollstuhl, Rollator, Gehstock oder eine andere Mobilitätshilfe

tr.#Which of these situations apply to your: Bu durumlardan hangileri bugünkü yolculuğunuz için geçerli?
tr.#Going to or from a bus, tram or metro s: Otobüs, tramvay veya metro durağına gidiyor ya da oradan geliyorum
tr.#Going to or from a parked car: Park edilmiş bir arabaya gidiyor ya da oradan geliyorum
tr.#Going to or from bicycle parking: Bisiklet parkına gidiyor ya da oradan geliyorum
tr.#Using a wheelchair, walker, cane or oth: Tekerlekli sandalye, yürüteç, baston veya başka bir hareket desteği kullanıyorum

fa.#Which of these situations apply to your: کدام یک از این موقعیت‌ها درباره سفر امروز شما صدق می‌کند؟
fa.#Going to or from a bus, tram or metro s: به ایستگاه اتوبوس، تراموا یا مترو می‌روم یا از آن برمی‌گردم
fa.#Going to or from a parked car: به خودروی پارک‌شده می‌روم یا از آن برمی‌گردم
fa.#Going to or from bicycle parking: به محل پارک دوچرخه می‌روم یا از آن برمی‌گردم
fa.#Accompanying a child (for example to sc: کودکی را همراهی می‌کنم (برای مثال به مدرسه)
fa.#Using a wheelchair, walker, cane or oth: از ویلچر، واکر، عصا یا وسیله کمک‌حرکتی دیگری استفاده می‌کنم

hu.#Which of these situations apply to your: Ezek közül melyik helyzet igaz az Ön mai útjára?
hu.#Going to or from a bus, tram or metro s: Busz-, villamos- vagy metrómegállóhoz megyek, vagy onnan jövök
hu.#Going to or from a parked car: Parkoló autóhoz megyek, vagy onnan jövök
hu.#Using a wheelchair, walker, cane or oth: Kerekesszéket, járókeretet, botot vagy más mozgást segítő eszközt használok

ar.#Which of these situations apply to your: أيّ من هذه الحالات تنطبق على تنقّلك اليوم؟
ar.#Going to or from a bus, tram or metro s: أذهب إلى محطة حافلة أو ترام أو مترو أو أعود منها
ar.#Going to or from a parked car: أذهب إلى سيارة مركونة أو أعود منها
ar.#Going to or from bicycle parking: أذهب إلى موقف الدراجات أو أعود منه
ar.#Using a wheelchair, walker, cane or oth: أستخدم كرسيًا متحركًا أو مشاية أو عصا أو وسيلة مساعدة أخرى على الحركة
